title: data for token.issue
description: Issue a token to a session. The plaintext token is returned once, in this response only. At most one active coordinator: set replace_coordinator to hand the role over (the old coordinator token is revoked).

device.description: A token for one device (a phone): it may not call ops marked x-device false (token.issue, token.revoke, roles.*, notify.set, times.import, goals.import, freshness.set).
